items.title: WoW: Forever Beta Development Notes - Racial Abilities and Traits Tuning
items.summary: WoW: Forever Beta Development Notes - Racial Abilities and Traits Tuning Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) As we approach the launch of WoW Forever, we’ve been reflecting on feedback we’ve heard on racial abilities and passive traits: Some players have expressed that some of the new racial traits feel too generic, while others have expressed concerns that some are objectively stronger than others. In taking a final pass on these, we’ve prioritized racial identity, which means that some races will naturally be slightly more effective than others at certain combat roles. In some places where we had replaced role- or class-focused racials with generic ones, we’re rolling those changes back. One exception to this is the weapon specialization racials, like humans’ Sword Specialization or orcs’ Axe Specialization. While those have a strong fantasy component to them, it is not healthy in the long run for future raid and dungeon loot tables to be evaluated through the lens of “required” weapon types. At the same time, we’re doing a tuning pass on some of the remaining passive bonuses to help ensure that they aren’t skewing outcomes in a way that limits player preferences. Regrowth healing increased by 10%. Does not affect PvP combat. Improved Swiftmend increases Swiftmend healing by 40% (was 30%). Does not affect PvP combat. Hunter Marksmanship Developers’ notes: These changes are intended to boost the area damage effectiveness of Marksmanship Hunters. Mage Fire All damage done increased by 5%. Does not affect PvP combat. items.title: Thank You For Testing the WoW Forever Beta
items.summary: Thank You For Testing the WoW Forever Beta Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The WoW Forever Beta is now closed, and we’re incredibly grateful to everyone who joined us over the last five weeks of playtesting, data gathering, bug reporting, and feedback. We’re now quickly moving into a period of a few short days where we will do some focused work on priority issues and the game service itself, so that it will be in good shape for launch day on November 4. And of course, we’ll open access to the character creation system on Tuesday, October 27, allowing everyone plenty of time to select the ruleset that will define your journey and snag the name that best fits your adventurer. You won’t have to wait until the game launches to make these big decisions. Also next week, we’re going to continue with our WoW Forever Podcast. If you haven’t consumed it all, this is a great time to catch up with everything the WoW Forever designers have had to say. The WoW: Forever Podcast: Episode 1 - Unpacking Beta Launch ft. ‪@Xaryu‬ The WoW: Forever Podcast: Episode 2 - Speed Running Classes ft. ‪@sodapoppin‬ The WoW: Forever Podcast: Episode 3 - Dive Into Dungeons With Devs ft. @ Hammer dancegaming The WoW: Forever Podcast: Episode 4 - The PvP Episode ft. ‪@TipsOutBaby‬ & ‪@Savixirl The WoW: Forever Podcast: Episode 5 - End of Beta Special If you can’t get enough WoW

items.title: The WoW Forever Beta Celebration is Underway
items.summary: The WoW Forever Beta Celebration is Underway Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) The WoW Forever Beta will end 24 hours from now, at 10:00 a.m. PDT on Friday, October 23, and until that fateful moment, we’re celebrating the joy and wonder of WoW Forever with 24 hours of shenanigans and upheaval in Zephras Isle, Dun Morogh, Elwynn Forest, Teldrassil, Durotar, Tirisfal Glades, and Mulgore. Log into the WoW Forever Beta for one last time and head to one of those zones to experience the madness, and join us in saying goodbye to the Beta. Please note: Shenanigans and upheaval in this one-time-only celebration almost certainly include items and experiences that will not be a part of WoW Forever after it launches on November 4. We hope everyone has fun on this last day of the WoW Forever Beta. Thank you so much for testing the game with us! WHO: you WHERE: Azeroth starting zones WHEN: now until Beta ends tomorrow WHAT: Pure insanity potential? [image or embed] — World of Warcraft ( @worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com ) 8:31 PM · Oct 22, 2026

items.title: The Roleplay-PvP Ruleset is Coming to WoW Forever
items.summary: The Roleplay-PvP Ruleset is Coming to WoW Forever Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Greetings, In a recent episode of the WoW Forever Podcast we discussed some of our concerns with adding a Roleplay-PVP ruleset in WoW Forever, but we also mentioned that we were still discussing the topic internally and watching player feedback. Over the last few days, we’ve carefully examined what it would take to add it to WoW Forever and decided to go for it. We will add a Roleplay-PVP Ruleset for launch on November 4. We’re also working hard to make it so that you can select the Roleplay-PvP ruleset and reserve names there next week when our Name Reservation period begins on Tuesday, October 27. We really appreciate the feedback and comments on this. Thank you!
